title: CBDT Issues SFT-2517 Format and Procedures for Depository Transactions
content:
# CBDT Issues SFT-2517 Format and Procedures for Depository Transactions

Ek important update hai! Government ne Depository Transactions ke liye Statement of Financial Transactions (SFT) ka naya format aur procedures announce kiye hain. Isse tax compliance aur pre-filling of returns mein aur clarity aayegi.

Yeh Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) dwara Directorate of Income Tax (Systems) ke through Notification No. 1 of 2026 dated September 10, 2026, se specify kiya gaya hai.

Kuch key points is prakar hain:
*   **Notification Reference:** Yeh Notification No. 1 of 2026 hai, jo September 10, 2026, ko jaari kiya gaya hai.
*   **Applicability:** Ismein Section 508(1) of the Income-tax Act, 2025, aur Rule 237 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026, ke तहत depository transactions ke liye SFT-2517 ka format aur guidelines di gayi hain.
*   **Purpose:** Iska main uddeshya listed securities ya units of Mutual Funds ke transfer par capital gains se related information ko income tax return ke pre-filling ke liye furnish karna hai.
*   **Reporting Persons:** Depositories (defined under section 2(1)(e) of the Depositories Act, 1996) ko yeh information report karni hogi.
*   **Submission Frequency:** SFT half-yearly basis par submit karna hoga.
*   **Due Dates:**
    *   Financial Year ke pehle half (ending September 30) ke liye: October 31 tak.
    *   Financial Year ke remaining half (ending March 31) ke liye: April 30 tak.
*   **Guidelines & Format:** Notification mein SFT ki preparation aur submission ke liye detailed guidelines (Annexures A aur B), Designated Director ke liye control statement format (Annexure C), aur data structure & validation rules (Annexures D aur E) specify kiye gaye hain.
*   **Taxpayer Reconciliation:** Reporting entities ko account holders ko bhi yeh reported information deni hogi, jisse woh Annual Information Statement (AIS) (Form 168) se reconcile kar saken.
